questions.wording: Does a body need, besides its matter, something that makes it the kind of body it is?

answers.label: Yes: matter alone does not make a thing what it is
No: matter alone suffices

questions.wording: Is there a first matter, common to all bodies and remaining through their changes, and what is it?

answers.label: Yes: a first matter, of itself pure potency without any form or act
Yes: the matter common to all bodies, which is extended substance
No: there is no such first matter, only the particular matters of each kind
Only as the most general idea of matter, abstracted by the intellect

questions.wording: Does matter exist of itself, or only through the form joined to it?

answers.label: Of itself: it has an existence of its own
Only through the form; it cannot exist without one, even by God's power

questions.wording: Besides its matter, and the size, shape, arrangement and motion of its parts, does a body have a substantial form?

answers.label: Yes: every kind of body has its own substantial form
No: the rational soul is the only substantial form; other bodies differ by the arrangement and motion of their parts

questions.wording: Where does the form of a newly generated thing come from?

answers.label: It is educed from the potency of the matter
It is brought into prepared matter by the heavens and stars
It is communicated by the begetter through the seed (the forms having been created at the beginning)
It is created by God
Nothing new comes to be but a new arrangement and motion of the parts

questions.wording: What becomes of the form of a thing when the thing perishes?

answers.label: It is annihilated
It is not annihilated but goes back into the potency of the matter

questions.wording: Can one body have more than one form at once?

answers.label: No: one form to a body
Yes: subordinate forms of the parts under the form of the whole

questions.wording: When a body is divided, is its form divided with it?
names: la: tota in toto, non tota in qualibet parte

answers.label: Yes: material forms are extended and divided with their matter
No

questions.wording: Is privation a principle of natural things?

answers.label: A principle of generation, not of the thing once made
No

questions.wording: Are the qualities of bodies real beings, distinct from the substance they are in?

answers.label: Yes: real accidents, separable at least by God's power
No: they are only modes or arrangements of the substance

questions.wording: Must the principles of natural things be clearly and distinctly known?

answers.label: Yes: nothing obscure may be admitted as a principle
No: the principles of things may be hidden and obscure to us

questions.wording: May the doctrines of the faith be used to test positions in natural philosophy?

answers.label: Yes
No

questions.wording: Is the rational soul of man a substance that can exist apart from the body?

answers.label: Yes
No
